selection_rule: For each frozen ARM07 teacher entry, select the latest unused canonical PumpSwap BUY event for the same mint and pool, with exact WSOL state, is_tracked_teacher=false, and received_at in [entry_received_at-30s, entry_received_at). Process frozen entries in chronological order; do not reuse a control event.
economics_rule: Apply the same 0.1 SOL quote-in, exact PumpSwap fee model, and fixed 30-second exit to matched controls.
comparison_rule: selected targets outperform controls only when selected PnL, profit factor, and win rate are all strictly greater than matched controls; missing controls yields null, not false.
promotion_effect: controls_outperformed must be true for promotion; false after the sample gate is a losing-arm decision.
